title: Filming: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings filmed a promotional clip for the ‘Goodnight Tonight’ on 3 April 1979.

It was directed by Keith ‘Keef’ McMillan at London’s Hammersmith Palais.

As with the single artwork, the male members of Wings dressed in tuxedos and had slicked-back hair, and Linda McCartney wore a purple dress and held a fan. Paul McCartney sang into an antique microphone borrowed from EMI.

I worked on the lighting for the video recording of Goodnight Tonight at the Hammersmith Palais in 1979. Someone alerted Paul McCartney that I was Old Boy of the Liverpool Institute High School for Boys like Paul. He sought me out and we spent a good while reminiscing about our time there and the schoolmasters we had shared.
Brian Allman
